title: In the Embrace of the Divine Mother | Swami Chidananda Giri

# In the Embrace of the Divine Mother

### Swami Chidananda Giri • Yogoda Satsanga Society of India

Welcome and blessings. Swami Chidananda Giri shares heart-felt reflections on how to live and breathe in the constant embrace of the Divine Mother. When we establish our home in Her love, we find a sanctuary that keeps us secure in any worldly crisis.

### The Nectar of Devotion

Devotion is the key that opens the treasury of Her presence. The more we pray with simple, unwavering sincerity, the more we feel the sweetness of Her divine love. She is closer to us than our own heartbeat.

> "Oh Divine Mother, Thou art my life, my strength, my love. Hide me in the temple of Thy silence, and let my soul merge with Thy cosmic joy."

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Heartfelt Chanting:** Spend a few minutes chanting *"Jai Ma"* before your daily meditation to soften your heart.
* **Daily Study:** Devote even fifteen minutes of study to the Guru's lessons to guide your intellect.
* **Keep Calm:** When difficulties arise, take a deep breath and remember: *"I am secure in Her maternal care."*
* **Evening Communion:** Speak to Her in the quiet hours of the night with absolute trust and surrender.

Jai Maharaj! Jai Ma!
